sentences.text: This writ petition is filed to issue a writ of certiorarified mandamus read with the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and call for the records on the file of the Respondent herein relating to its impugned proceedings bearing Na.Ka.No.16342/2021/B-1 dated 23.09.2022 and quash the same as illegal, appropriate orders on merits and in accordance with law and re convey the un-utilized lands in S.No.259/1B1A.lin Mecehry Rural Housing Society.

sentences.text: 2. Mr.R.P.Murugan Raja, learned Government Advocate submits that they have given a notice to the petitioner and considered in the enquiry and stating that the lands have been acquired under due process of law under the Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Then the petitioner filed a representation before the respondents for re- conveyance.
The respondents have passed the order, since the land acquired, this land has been alloted only for the park and also for the public purpose.
Therefore, they cannot re-
convey it.
3. Mr.K.S.Narayanan, learned Counsel for the petitioner submits that it is not a vacant land and some third party has encroached the said https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis land.
Since the respondents have already taken effective steps to remove the encroachment in a manner known to law.
The petitioner's claim is liable to be dismissed.
Accordingly, the writ petition is dismissed.

Further the respondents are directed to evict the encroachment and recover the land and file an action taken report within a period of two (2) months.
4.
With the above direction, this writ petition stands disposed of accordingly.
No costs.
